Necessary work order copies along with the completion certificate ha ve to be submitted along with the offer as proof for the above require ment. In case of running contracts, the value of work completed as on the tender opening date will be considered. Otherwise the offer will be rejected. All MSE (Micro and Small Enterprise) bidders and all start-ups recogni zed by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade a re exempted from the above condition (Sl. No. 01).

Turnover criteria is given below: A) The bidder has to submit financial accounts (audited, if applicable comprising of Audit report, Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss A/c Statem ent and Notes/Schedules pertaining to Turnover/Sales/Revenue), f or three years (or from the date of incorporation, whichever is less) as on tender due date to review the above criteria. In case th e incorporation of vendor is less than 3 years, average annual fina ncial turnover shall be calculated based on available information a s below: ‐ 1) If the accounts are available for <= 1 Financial Year, the Avera ge Annual Turnover shall be calculated based on available infor mation divided by 1 (One). 2) If the accounts are available for >1 but < = 2 Financial Years, t 2 he Average Annual Turnover shall be calculated based on avail able information divided by 2 (Two). 3) If the accounts are available for >2 but <= 3 Financial Years, th e Average Annual Turnover shall be calculated based on availa ble information divided by 3 (Three). B) Average annual financial turnover of last 3 Financial Years (begin ning from 01.04.2022-31.03.2025) should not be less than Rs.0.20 lacs. C) While calculating Annual Turnover / Sales, other operating incom e and other income shall not be considered. All MSE (Micro and Small Enterprise) bidders and all start-ups recogni zed by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade a re exempted from the above condition (Sl. No. 02). Considering the criticality of the DG Set for eme Local office address rgency power backup during EB failure, a local s of your firm. ervice presence within a 30 km radius is essenti al to ensure restoration of the DG Set during the 3 six-month warranty period. All MSE (Micro and Small Enterprises) bidders and start-ups recognize d by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade shall fulfil the requirements specified under Sl. No. 03. Other Vendors of Non MSE, which do not qualify any of the above Pre- Qualification Requirements, will be summarily rejected. BHEL reserves the right to verify the information provided by the bidder, in cas e the information provided by the bidder is found to be false/incorrect, the offer shall be rejected. BHEL reserves its right to reject the tender on account of unsa tisfactory past performance by the bidder in other purchase orders awarded un der different enquiry.

Contract period: The total contract period is two months from date of commencement of work. Liquidated Damages / Penalty: In case of delay in completion of work, Liquidated Damages (LD)/Penalty will be imposed at the rate of 0.5% of the respective invoice BOQ per week of delay or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 10% of the PO value. Payment terms: Payments will be made by BHEL, subject to submission of the contractor’s invoic e, upon confirmation of satisfactory completion of the scheduled works by In Ch arge of Transport. The vendor shall submit invoices along with all requisite docu ments through the SUVIDHA portal. Payment will be made within 45 days for MS E, 60 days for Medium Enterprises and 90 days for non MSE Bidders from the da te of submission of bills along with all the enclosures as required by the BHEL. Payment through electronic fund transfer (EFT) / RTGS) only after ded ucting Bank charges. All MSME suppliers are required to mandatorily route their invoices through any RBI- authorized TReDS platform (e.g., RXIL & M1xchange) Taxes and Duties: Applicable GST is 18%. This GST amount will be reimbursed to the contractor on submission of proof of remittance challan and uploading the details GSTN netwo rk within the statutory time period. In case any change in GST as per Governme nt Notification, the same may be adopted during the contract period. Compliance: a) Adhering to all safety, statutory, and environmental regulations applicable at BHEL Ranipet site. b) Compliance with BHEL safety procedures, PPE requirements.
